subject: MAP Recap: Redwood + Acme POC - milestones & next steps
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@acme.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 4 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Recap & MAP: Redwood + Acme POC next steps

Hi Alex -

Thanks again for your time this morning. Quick recap from our discovery and a proposed Mutual Action Plan (MAP) so we have alignment on scope, stakeholders, success metrics, and timing. Please review and confirm or suggest changes.

Key pain points you called out:
- Latency spikes on peak inference requests causing poor UX for customers (p50 goal currently ~350ms).
- Unpredictable token costs across bursty workloads; need better unit economics and cost cap.
- Data residency & audit requirements for customer PII; procurement requires evidence of audit logs and SOC2 artifacts.

Primary goals for the POC:
1) Demonstrate stable p50 latency <200ms for the main prompt pattern at 95th percentile of current traffic.
2) Show cost predictability: per-token cost model with projected savings vs current infra.
3) Validate secure integration with Acme VPC and encrypted KMS-managed keys.

Stakeholders / decision-makers you listed:
- Alex Johnson (Product Lead) - champion
- Samir Patel (Head of ML) - technical sign-off
- Julia Kim (Procurement) - contract/PO
- CTO/Exec review: tentative Sept 14 exec check-in

Proposed MAP (milestones & owners):
- Aug 10: Kickoff & environment access (Acme: Alex/Samir; Redwood: Marissa/Vivek) - owner: Marissa - deliverable: env access, SSO/KMS details
- Aug 17: POC infra & model staging ready (Redwood) - owner: Vivek - deliverable: endpoint URL, perf baseline
- Aug 24: Baseline tuning & load testing (joint) - owner: Dev Patel (Redwood SE) - deliverable: perf report vs success metrics
- Sep 07: Success evaluation & SOW scoping (joint) - owner: Alex/Marissa - deliverable: evaluation report + proposal
- Sep 14: Executive review (Acme execs & Redwood GTM) - owner: Alex - deliverable: exec summary
- Sep 30: Decision / procurement/PO (Acme) - owner: Julia - deliverable: signed PO or next steps

Open items / asks for Acme:
- Confirm technical contact for network/VPC access (we have Samir tentatively listed).
- Confirm procurement contact who will review PO and terms (Julia?) and expected contract review timeline.
- Share a representative prompt set and traffic profile (examples and qps distribution).

I attached a draft MAP spreadsheet that includes milestones, owners, and expected deliverables. I can update and re-upload after you confirm the procurement contact and decision window.

Attachments: redwood-acme-map-draft.xlsx (spreadsheet, 24KB)

Next steps:
- Alex: confirm procurement contact & decision cadence by EOD Wed (Aug 5)
- Samir: share test prompt samples and target throughput by Aug 7
- Marissa/Vivek/Dev: lock in kickoff on Aug 10 (I sent a calendar hold)

Thanks - looking forward to getting this moving.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.ai | (415) 555-0134

--
Redwood Inference - production-first LLM inference

Thanks Marissa - this looks great and captures everything from the call. A couple quick notes:
- Confirmed: Julia Kim is the procurement lead; she will review terms and get back on PO timing (cc'd).
- Technical contact: Samir will own network/VPC access. I asked him to reply with required hostnames and a point of contact for our infra team.
- Decision window: We are aiming for an exec review on Sept 14 and a final decision by Sept 30. If the POC shows the expected perf/cost, we should be able to move to PO.
